identificationModule.briefTitle: Endostar First-line Treatment of Advanced NSCLC
identificationModule.officialTitle: The Efficacy and Safety of Continuous Administration of Endostar Combined With Chemotherapy for Patients With Advanced no Small Cell Lung Cancer: An Open-label, no Randomized Controlled Multicenter Phase II Study

descriptionModule.briefSummary: Explore the efficacy and safety of the treatment of Endostar continuous intravenous injection pump combined GP（gemcitabine+cisplatin） scheme for first-line advanced non small cell lung cancer and maintenance treatment.
descriptionModule.detailedDescription:
Explore the efficacy and safety of the treatment of Endostar continuous intravenous injection pump combined GP（gemcitabine+cisplatin） scheme for first-line advanced non small cell lung cancer and maintenance treatment.

main objectives: PFS (progression-free survival) the secondary goal: ORR (overall response rate), DCR (disease control rate) and OS（overall survival）

armGroups.label: Endostar + Gemcitabine and Cisplatin
armGroups.description: Patients in this group will be given endostar combined with gemcitabine and cisplatine.

armGroups.label: Gemcitabine and Cisplatin
armGroups.description: Patients in this group will be given gemcitabine and cisplatine.

interventions.name: Endostar
interventions.description: Endostar,30mg continuous intravenous injection pump, d1-d7,21 days as one cycle, 4 cycles in total

interventions.name: Gemcitabine
interventions.description: Gemcitabine,1000mg/m2, i.v, d1 and d8 in each cycle, 21 days as one cycle, 4 cycles in total

interventions.name: Cisplatin
interventions.description: Cisplatin,75mg/m2, i.v, d1 in each cycle, 21 days as one cycle, 4 cycles in total

primaryOutcomes.description: PFS is a tumor progression or death time of a patient who has an objective record on the date of enrollment. PFS calculation end if the patient was lost, unknown death , or other anti tumor therapy was used.

secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Time Frame: change from Baseline at the week 6, 12 of the treatment phase, the month 3, 6, 9 and 12, 15, 18, 21, 24, 27, 30 ,33,36 of the followup phase.
